title: Atinuke Wole-Ilori
text: After earning my BSc in Information Science and Media Studies, I relocated from Nigeria to Canada in December 2024 to advance my technical expertise. I am now channeling my background into becoming a well-rounded and proficient data scientist by the end of my degree. I’m eager to leverage this unique combination of skills to drive impactful, data-informed solutions.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Diving head-first into the MDS program has been a total whirlwind, but meeting so many amazing, brilliant peers has made the crazy ride completely worth it. The workload is definitely no joke—let’s just say my coffee intake has officially hit record highs! It’s going to be a wild, challenging ride, but I am so ready to tackle every single week ahead.



Chilling on a couch

title: About
text: Originally from Lagos, Nigeria, I’ve always been driven by a strong curiosity for tech and problem-solving. Over the past five years, I’ve built a solid foundation across technical support, IT coordination, and research following my degree in Information Science and Media Studies. Today, I’m building on that experience as a Master of Data Science student at UBC!

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
My interest in Data Science was sparked during my undergraduate studies, where I first discovered how powerful data-driven decision-making can be. The field naturally brought together the exact skills, analytical thinking, and areas of knowledge I was eager to explore. Choosing to pursue it further was a seamless blend of my background and core professional curiosity.

title: About
text:
Outside of Data Science
When I’m not diving into data, you’ll usually find me baking up something delicious, picking up my guitar, or lost in a great book. I also love a good game, whether on a screen or a board. These creative outlets keep me balanced, inspired, and always curious.
